authoring.order: Each Close: Universe → Alpha / Signals → Portfolio → Risk → final target.
authoring.stopLossHelp: Leave blank to disable. Uses actual acquisition cost including buy fees. Checks at Close and attempts to sell at the next Open; gaps or trading restrictions can increase the loss.
authoring.maximumHoldingHelp: Leave blank to disable. The first actual buy counts as session 1. At the Nth Close, request an exit at the next Open. Adding shares does not restart the count.
authoring.minimumHoldingHelp: Leave blank to disable. Younger holdings retain their shares and occupy portfolio slots during ordinary changes. Risk exits can still reduce or sell them.

python.directExample: The example uses ordinary Python variables for the lookback and improvement threshold. Edit them directly in the source.
python.historyContext: data.close_prices(days) reads adjusted closing prices. data.history(field_id, days) reads other fields. Results contain sessions (oldest first) and values keyed by instrument ID. Missing values are None; check len(result.sessions) when history is short. Each request accepts 1–253 trading sessions, including the current Close.
python.frameworkContext: data.framework provides the selected universe, active signals and current proposal for this stage. retained_proposal is a reference and is never automatically replayed.
python.state: Optional self.state stores JSON-compatible memory across sessions. Other instance attributes are recreated. Helpers construct decisions; only the returned decision is applied. A failed invocation commits neither its state nor its target. Data access has bounded fields, instruments, reads and execution time.

framework.universe_selection: Subclass UniverseSelection. Return self.select(instruments) to replace the selection. None retains the previous available selection.
framework.alpha: Subclass Alpha. Return self.signals({stock: score}, valid_for_sessions=2). None retains unexpired signals. Signals do not submit orders.
framework.portfolio_construction: Subclass PortfolioConstruction. Return self.target_weights(weights) for a full portfolio target, or None for no update.
framework.risk_management: Subclass RiskManagement. Return self.limit_positions({stock: maximum_shares}) to cap actual holdings, or self.replace(decision) to replace the proposal. self.replace(None) cancels the proposal; None passes it through.

python.systemInputHelp: data provides the decision date, candidates and history methods. account contains actual cash, positions, fills and rejections.
python.strategyOutputHelp: Return self.target_weights({stock: 0.8}) for a full portfolio target, {} inside target_weights to exit all holdings, or None to make no update. Unlisted holdings exit; unallocated weight stays in cash.
python.systemExecutionHelp: Decide after Close; attempt trades at the next trading session’s Open. The platform simulates fills, costs, cash and performance. A target is not a guaranteed fill.
python.accountReference: account.cash_cny is actual cash; account.positions contains instrument_id, execution_shares and holding_age. account.fills and account.rejections contain this session’s execution facts. Money is represented as decimal strings. These observations are read-only.
python.targetReference: For local changes, return self.increase_to_weights(weights) to buy only, self.reduce_exposure(maximum) to reduce exposure proportionally, or self.limit_positions({stock: shares}) to cap named holdings. self.with_limits(decision, maximum_shares=..., maximum_exposure=...) adds caps without relaxing existing ones.
python.readLimits: Data is pinned to this run and ends at the current Close. Each invocation allows 64 reads, up to 262,144 stock/session cells per read and 1,048,576 in total. Results → Trading details → Python data reads shows actual successful reads. Configuration checking does not verify every dynamic branch.

drawdown.title: Portfolio drawdown
drawdown.help: Leave all three fields blank to disable. When enabled, complete every field. Close account value is compared with the current risk-cycle peak; the next Open applies the stock exposure cap.
drawdown.recovery: Cooldown starts after the trigger day. Recovery also requires a new portfolio decision; it never buys back from an old target. The cap only reduces higher targets. Execution can be blocked, and the main Open performance history is not reset.

takeProfit.title: Cumulative take profit
takeProfit.help: Off when no tiers are configured. At the first trigger, freeze the holding baseline. A 30% tier followed by 60% sells another 30% of that baseline, not 60% of the remaining shares. Ordinary selections cannot add shares until this holding fully exits.
takeProfit.footer: Both percentages must increase with each tier. Checks use acquisition cost at Close; fills at the following Open determine actual progress. Blocked sales and rounding remain uncompleted.

frozen.feesHelp: Minimum commission applies to each filled child order. Slippage changes execution prices and is not charged again as a fee.
frozen.drawdownSummary: Threshold {{threshold}}%; stock exposure cap {{cap}}%; cooldown {{cooldown}} trading sessions. A fresh portfolio decision is required for recovery.
frozen.baseline: Baseline freezes at the first trigger. No ordinary additions until full exit.
frozen.evaluated: Evaluated at Close; the next Open determines execution.

python.directExample: 示例的回看周期和改善阈值都是普通 Python 变量，直接在源码中修改。
python.historyContext: data.close_prices(days) 读取复权收盘价；data.history(字段 ID, days) 读取其他字段。结果的 sessions 按时间从早到晚排列，values 按股票 ID 索引，缺失值为 None。历史不足时检查 len(result.sessions)。每次可读取 1–253 个交易日，包含当前收盘。
python.frameworkContext: data.framework 提供本步骤的选股结果、活跃信号和当前组合建议。retained_proposal 仅供参考，不会自动重复执行。
python.state: 需要跨日记忆时使用 self.state，内容必须可序列化为 JSON；其他实例属性每次重新创建。辅助方法只构造决策，最终返回的决策才会执行。调用失败时不接受新状态和新目标。字段、股票范围、累计读取量和执行时间由平台限制。

framework.universe_selection: 继承 UniverseSelection，返回 self.select(股票列表) 更新选股；None 保留上次仍可用的选择。
framework.alpha: 继承 Alpha，返回 self.signals({股票: 分数}, valid_for_sessions=2) 更新信号；None 保留未过期信号。信号不会直接下单。
framework.portfolio_construction: 继承 PortfolioConstruction，返回 self.target_weights(权重) 设置整体目标组合；None 表示不更新。
framework.risk_management: 继承 RiskManagement，返回 self.limit_positions({股票: 最大股数}) 限制实际持仓，或 self.replace(决策) 替换组合建议。self.replace(None) 取消建议；None 让本次建议继续执行。

python.systemInputHelp: data 提供决策日期、候选股票和历史数据读取方法；account 提供实际现金、持仓、成交和拒单记录。
python.strategyOutputHelp: return self.target_weights({股票: 0.8}) 设置整体目标组合；传入 {} 表示清仓；return None 表示本次不更新。未列出的持仓退出，未分配的权重保留为现金。
python.systemExecutionHelp: 收盘后运行策略，下一交易日开盘尝试成交。平台负责交易模拟、费用、账户和收益计算；目标持仓不等于实际成交。
python.accountReference: account.cash_cny 是实际现金；account.positions 包含 instrument_id（股票 ID）、execution_shares（实际股数）和 holding_age（持仓交易日数）。account.fills 和 account.rejections 是当日成交与拒单事实。金额采用十进制字符串表示。以上观察均为只读。
python.targetReference: 局部调整可返回 self.increase_to_weights(weights) 只加仓、self.reduce_exposure(maximum) 按比例降低总仓位，或 self.limit_positions({股票: 股数}) 限制指定持仓。self.with_limits(decision, maximum_shares=..., maximum_exposure=...) 追加限制，已有更严格的限制继续有效。
python.readLimits: 数据固定于本次回测版本，最晚到当前收盘。每次回调最多读取 64 次，单次最多 262,144 个“股票 × 交易日”数据格，累计最多 1,048,576 个。回测结果的“交易明细 → Python 数据读取”展示实际成功读取记录。检查配置不会验证所有动态分支。
